components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The sunny, highest-priority action in a local group.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #f6b642; color: #201814; font: 800 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(184,101,43,.18); transition: background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #ffc85c; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f6b642; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: A high-contrast action for cream and white surfaces.
components.css: .ds-button-dark { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: #201814; color: #fff; font: 800 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(32,24,20,.14); transition: background 200ms ease, transform 200ms ease; } .ds-button-dark:hover { background: #4b2f22; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-button-dark:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f6b642; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quieter supporting action with a lifted white surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(32,24,20,.1); border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: #201814; font: 800 14px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(32,24,20,.14); transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: #fff8ec; } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f6b642; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Counter Card
components.description: The default softly lifted content and ordering container.
components.html:
POPULAR

Golden Scramble

Eggs and cheese on your choice of fresh bagel.
components.css: .ds-counter-card { width: 280px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(32,24,20,.1); border-radius: 24px; background: #fff; color: #201814; box-shadow: 0 18px 60px rgba(32,24,20,.14); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-counter-card span { color: #a55325; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .14em; } .ds-counter-card h3 { margin: 10px 0 6px; font: 900 22px/1.15 Georgia, serif; } .ds-counter-card p { margin: 0; color: #4b2f22; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-counter-card:hover { border-color: rgba(246,182,66,.75); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A generous white ordering field with warm focus feedback.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: #201814; font: 700 14px/1.3 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(32,24,20,.1); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; color: #201814; font: 400 16px/1.4 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #f6b642; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(246,182,66,.2); }

components.name: Selected Category Chip
components.description: The active category state in menu navigation.
components.css: .ds-chip-selected { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid #201814; border-radius: 9999px; background: #201814; color: #fff; font: 800 13px/1 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-chip-selected:hover { background: #4b2f22; } .ds-chip-selected:focus-visible { outline: 4px solid #f6b642; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Header Navigation Link
components.description: A compact pill link for the fixed cream header.

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like stepping up to a well-loved local counter: warm, direct, tactile, and full of real food. Cream paper tones, dark espresso surfaces, honey accents, bold labels, and generous rounded shapes make it friendly without becoming childish.

Ordering speed is part of the character. Information is grouped like a clear counter menu, controls feel substantial under a thumb, and the strongest contrast always points toward the next useful action. The existing video hero and logo-led navigation remain signature anchors; refinement should make the surrounding experience more coherent rather than replace them.
keyCharacteristics: Bold hierarchy with compact, practical copy
Tactile controls and softly lifted surfaces
Mobile-first ordering with clear progress and feedback
Real cafe imagery instead of decorative stock graphics

rules.name: The Honey Means Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve strong honey fills for primary actions, focus, active state, or one deliberate highlight in a local group.

rules.name: The Counter Scan Rule
rules.body: A customer should be able to find the item name, price, option state, and next action without reading the surrounding paragraph copy.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Within a local group, lift the action or surface that matters most; supporting elements stay bordered and comparatively quiet.

dos: Do preserve the video-led hero, official logo, warm palette, and logo-led navigation as signature anchors.
Do use real food and cafe photography when imagery adds decision value.
Do make menu name, price, options, availability, and order action easy to scan.
Do keep touch targets at least 44 pixels and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do use charcoal bands to create rhythm between cream and white surfaces.
donts: Don't introduce unsupported awards, claims, review sources, or generic marketing proof.
Don't turn every card into a floating object or every accent into honey.
Don't hide ordering state, required choices, errors, or price changes behind hover-only behavior.
Don't add decorative gradients, stock illustration, or novelty icons that compete with the real cafe imagery.
Don't sacrifice mobile ordering speed or legibility for desktop density.
